name: Winterspring
summary: Snowstorms sweep Winterspring, where old dangers still shape life. High on Mount Hyjal's northeastern slopes, the valley lies above Moonglade and Felwood. Ancient Highborne ruins and fierce predators mark the land, while Everlook stands at its heart. Blue dragons shelter here, and demonic corruption grips the southern heights.

sections.title: A Realm of Perpetual Frost
sections.body: Snowstorms cross Winterspring's high forests, bluffs, and frozen lakes. Far below the summit, the valley rises above the surrounding wilds under cold mountain air. Vast roots of Nordrassil, the World Tree, arch through the drifts, twisted in the struggles of the Third War. Northern Kalimdor is mostly warm and thick with trees, but these alpine woods shelter frostsabers, chimaeras, yetis, and winter bears.

sections.title: Crossroads and Outposts
sections.body: Ancient passages through Timbermaw Hold link Winterspring with Felwood and Moonglade. Uncorrupted furbolgs guard the way and scrutinize travelers who pass through. At the valley's center, goblins of the Steamwheedle Cartel run Everlook, a trading town open to both Alliance and Horde. Its trade, engineering, and warm fires offer shelter from the mountain cold.

sections.title: Old Ghosts and Blue Drakes
sections.body: Kel'Theril's ruined pillars rise beside a frozen lake, haunted by the Highborne who once lived there. Reckless sorcerers shattered the cursed Crystal of Zin-Malor, and madness claimed them. Farther south, Mazthoril's caves hold the blue dragonflight's Kalimdor stronghold. Haleh, its matron protector, watches over Malygos's brood as they guard arcane currents and face nearby threats.

sections.title: The Looming Shadow of the Gorge
sections.body: Darkwhisper Gorge cuts through the calm at Winterspring's southern edge. Demonic forces left from the Third War crawl through its jagged canyons, blocking the high approaches to Mount Hyjal's summit. Winterfall furbolgs have also fallen to foul corruption. Independent researchers such as Donova Snowden investigate the spreading taint as it threatens the valley's wildlife.

faq.q: How do I get to Winterspring?
faq.answer: Winterspring lies beyond Timbermaw Hold, a network of tunnels in northeastern Felwood. The Timbermaw furbolgs attack travelers they judge hostile, so you must earn their trust to pass in peace. The eastern exit opens onto Winterspring's snowy slopes.

faq.q: Who runs the town of Everlook?
faq.answer: The Steamwheedle Cartel runs Everlook. Its goblin traders keep the town neutral, so Horde and Alliance travelers may use its flight masters, repair vendors, banking vaults, and trade goods as long as they keep the peace.

faq.q: What are the ghosts haunting Lake Kel'Theril?
faq.answer: The ghosts are Highborne night elves who lived in Kel'Theril ten thousand years ago. Their sorcerers tampered with the stolen Crystal of Zin-Malor, and its shattering unleashed a curse that drove them mad. Centuries later, expeditions of high elves also fell to madness and now haunt the frozen ruins beside their ancestors.

faq.q: Why are the Winterfall furbolgs aggressive?
faq.answer: The Winterfall furbolgs have fallen to a spreading, unnatural corruption that has driven their clan into maddened hostility. Nearby Timbermaw have kept their sanity, while dark influences hold the Winterfall. Researchers such as Donova Snowden study the taint and clear the clan's encampments.

Mazthoril is the blue dragonflight's main roost and sanctuary on Kalimdor. Wyrmkin, elite whelps, and ancient drakes guard draconic relics and arcane secrets in its cavernous spires under Haleh's watch. She is the consort of the Aspect Malygos.
Darkwhisper Gorge is a treacherous canyon at the valley's southern edge, held by powerful demons left from the Third War. They guard the dangerous trails leading toward Mount Hyjal's heights.

faq.q: Can you train or tame frostsabers here?
faq.answer: At Frostsaber Rock in Winterspring's far north, the night elf Rivern Frostwind tends the native white cats. Help him secure provisions and protect the pride, and you may prove worthy of learning to rear and ride a Frostsaber.

angles.text: Winterspring holds Icecap, an alpine herb found nowhere else, along with Mountain Silversage and rare Black Lotus. Alchemists seek Icecap for advanced concoctions.
Winterspring's icy crags and cavern walls yield Small and Rich Thorium Veins, as well as rare Truesilver deposits.

Winterspring carries deep ties to elven history. The Druids of the Talon rested for millennia in its barrow dens, Kel'Theril lies in ruins, and Nordrassil's exposed roots bear damage from the Battle of Mount Hyjal.
High above Moonglade, Winterspring holds sacred meaning for druids. During the Third War, Malfurion Stormrage awakened the Druids of the Talon from their ancient sleep here.
Alliance heroes visit Rivern Frostwind at Frostsaber Rock to brave Winterspring's cold and earn the loyalty of the prestigious Winterspring Frostsaber mounts.
